title: Antiphon #181 - Psalm 130 (129): 3-4
author: Let Us All Rejoice
snippet: If you, O Lord, should mark iniquities, Lord, who could stand? But with you is found forgiveness, O God of Israel.

title: I Shall live in the house of the Lord
author: Psalm 23: 1-3a, 3b-4, 5, 6
snippet: I shall live in the house of the Lord all the days of my life.

title: Acclamation - 22nd & 28th Sundays OT(A)
author: Ephesians 1:17–18
snippet: May the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ enlighten in the eyes of our hearts, that we may know what is the hope that belongs to our call.

title: Prayer of St. Francis
author: Sebastian Temple
snippet: Make me a channel of your peace. Where there is hatred, let me bring your love. Where there is injury, your pardon, Lord, And where there’s doubt, true faith in you.

title: Antiphon #182 - Cf. Psalm 34:11
author: Let Us All Rejoice
snippet: The rich suffer want and go hungry, but those who seek the Lord lack no blessing.

title: Taste and See
author: Steve Angrisano
snippet: Taste and see the goodness of the Lord, the goodness of the Lord. Taste and see the goodness of the Lord, the goodness of the Lord.

title: Shepherd Me, O God
author: Marty Haugen
snippet: Shepherd me, O God, beyond my wants, beyond my fears, from death into life.

title: Grateful
author: Tom Tomaszek
snippet: Grateful for the life you give us, Thankful for your Holy Son. Joyful in your spirit flowing Overall, O God of Love. Grateful for the Bread of Heaven, Thankful for your Holy Word, Joyful in your mercy flowing, We will praise You.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lord, have mercy. Christ have mercy. Lord have mercy

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Glory to God! Glory to God in the highest, and on earth, peace to people of goodwill.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Holy, holy, holy Lord God of hosts. Heaven and earth are full of your glory. Hosanna in the highest. Blessed is he who comes in the moment of the Lord. Hosanna in the highest.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: When we eat this bread and drink this cup, we proclaim your death, O Lord, until you come again.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lamb of God, You take away the sins of the world; have mercy, have mercy on us.
